literature_notes: Both ledger lines (L1, L2) describe C-terminal HA tagging of ERVV-2 EnvV2. The computed topology places residues 470–535 in the intracellular compartment (TM: 460–469; IC: 470–535), so the C-terminal tag sits on the cytoplasmic face and does not qualify as an extracellular surface site. No ledger line reports any insertion at the extracellular N-terminus (after SP cleavage at residue 21) or in any extracellular loop. The ledger does not support any extracellular tag site for this protein.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal HA tag confirmed to produce a membrane-associated protein (L1, L2), but the C-terminus lies in the intracellular domain (residues 470–535, 66 aa past the TM boundary at 469); not an extracellular surface site.
